SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DISTINCT BUYER , TAX_BILL_NO , APRV_NO FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_AR_SEND WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'LOTT') AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.TAX_BILL_TYPE AS TRAN_TY , A.BUYER AS BUYER , A.PO_NO , A.PO_SEQ , A.GR_NO , A.GR_SEQ , A.APRV_NO , A.APRV_EMAIL , A.KEY_1 AS CGC_BRANCH , A.ORIGIN_APRV_NO , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS MATNR , A.DESCRIPTION AS MAKTX , A.SPECIFICATION AS SPEC , A.GR_DATE AS GR_DATE , A.KEY_2 AS SAKTO , A.KEY_3 AS KOSTL , A.KEY_4 AS ZZCCTR , A.KEY_5 AS MWSKZ , A.GR_AMT AS SUP_AMT , A.TAX_TYPE AS TAXTY , A.PO_QTY AS PO_MENGE , A.UNIT_MEASURE AS PO_MEINS , A.GR_QTY AS GR_MENGE , A.UNIT_MEASURE AS GR_MEINS , A.UNIT_PRICE AS NETPR , A.CUR AS WAERS , A.VEN_NO AS VEN_NO , A.VEN_NM AS VEN_NM , A.VEN_CEO AS VEN_CEO , A.VEN_TEL AS VEN_TEL , A.VEN_COUNTRY AS VEN_COUNTRY , A.VEN_ADDR AS VEN_ADDR , A.VEN_BUSINESS AS VEN_BUSINESS , A.VEN_INDUSTRY AS VEN_INDUSTRY FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_AR_SEND A WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.TAX_BILL_NO = '$G_RS.TAX_BILL_NO$' AND A.APRV_NO = '$G_RS.APRV_NO$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_AR_SEND A SET A.IF_FLAG = 'Y' , A.IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , A.IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.TAX_BILL_NO = '$G_RS.TAX_BILL_NO$' AND A.APRV_NO = '$G_RS.APRV_NO$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_AR_SEND A SET A.IF_FLAG = 'E' , A.IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , A.IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.TAX_BILL_NO = '$G_RS.TAX_BILL_NO$' AND A.APRV_NO = '$G_RS.APRV_NO$'
